title: Aviary observed AI answer citation analysis
description: A bounded local summary of manually supplied AI answer snapshots. It does not estimate provider rankings or citation probability.

source.const: Aviary observed AI answer citation analysis

incompleteCitationListObservations.description: Observations marked incomplete or inferred incomplete because exactly 50 cited URLs were supplied without an explicit complete marker.

ownedFirstCitationMeanReciprocalRankPerc.description: Optional mean reciprocal rank of the first owned citation across snapshots with an owned citation.

promptsWithOwnedCitation.description: Distinct normalized exact prompts with at least one owned-citing snapshot.

ownedCitationPromptCoveragePercent.description: Share of distinct normalized exact prompts with at least one owned-citing snapshot.

ownedCitationPositionBuckets.description: Observed owned citation source positions; present only when owned domains were configured.

observationsWithKnownOwnedCitationState.description: Snapshots whose owned-citation state is known because the citation list is complete or an owned citation was observed.

observationsWithUnknownOwnedCitationStat.description: Incomplete source-list snapshots with no observed owned citation; an omitted citation could change the owned-citation state.

ownedCitationCoverageAmongKnownObservati.description: Owned-citing snapshots divided by snapshots with a known owned-citation state; null when no snapshot state is known.

ownedCitationCoverageUpperBoundPercent.description: Conservative upper bound that assumes every unknown snapshot contains an owned citation. The observed owned-citation coverage is the lower bound; these are capture-completeness bounds, not a statistical confidence interval.

promptsWithKnownOwnedCitationState.description: Distinct prompt groups with a known owned-citation state because an owned citation was positively observed or every captured source list for the prompt group is complete.

promptsWithUnknownOwnedCitationState.description: Distinct prompt groups with no owned citation observed and at least one incomplete source list; an omitted citation could change the prompt-reach state even if another capture of the prompt had a complete list.

ownedCitationPromptCoverageAmongKnownPro.description: Owned-cited prompt groups divided by prompt groups with a known owned-citation state; null when no prompt state is known.

ownedCitationPromptCoverageUpperBoundPer.description: Conservative prompt-reach upper bound that assumes every unknown prompt group has an owned citation. The observed prompt coverage is the lower bound; these are capture-completeness bounds, not a statistical confidence interval.

ownedCitationPromptCoverageAmongKnownPro.description: Wilson interval for observed owned-citation reach among prompt groups with a known owned-citation state; null when not available.

ownedCitationPromptCoveragePercent.description: Share of this provider's exact prompt groups with at least one owned-citing snapshot.

promptCoveragePercent.description: Share of all distinct normalized exact prompts that cited this domain.

firstPositionPromptCoveragePercent.description: Share of all distinct exact prompts where this source appeared at citation-list position one in at least one captured answer.

topThreePromptCoveragePercent.description: Share of all distinct exact prompts where this source appeared in the first three citation-list positions in at least one captured answer.

observationsWithDomain.description: Entity-mentioned, no-owned-citation captures that listed this alternative domain. Optional for compatibility with older reports.

firstPositionCitationEvents.description: Observed citation URL events for this alternative domain at source-list position one. Optional for compatibility with older reports.

topThreeCitationEvents.description: Observed citation URL events for this alternative domain in source-list positions one through three. Optional for compatibility with older reports.

observationsWithFirstPositionCitation.description: Entity-mentioned, no-owned-citation captures with this domain at source-list position one. Optional for compatibility with older reports.

observationsWithTopThreeCitation.description: Entity-mentioned, no-owned-citation captures with this domain in the first three source-list positions. Optional for compatibility with older reports.

providerProfiles.description: Optional for compatibility with previously saved version 1 reports; current reports include one profile per retained provider/prompt group.

citationDomainProfiles.description: Top-ten per-domain event and source-list position profiles for this month/provider/cohort row.

citationPositionBucketChanges.description: Previous sampled month all-citation rank-share changes.

latestMonthlyPairedOwnedPromptReachHolmA.description: Holm step-down adjusted exact McNemar p-value for this segment's latest sampled-month transition, adjusted across the report-wide family of latest provider/topic/intent transitions. Null when detail or paired data is incomplete.

ownedCitationPositionBuckets.description: Current month owned citation rank distribution; present only when owned domains were configured.

ownedCitationPositionBucketChanges.description: Previous sampled month owned citation rank-share changes.

unknownOwnedCitationStateObservations.description: Incomplete-list observations without a positively observed owned citation; the owned-citation state is unknown.

unknownOwnedCitationStateObservationShar.description: Share of monthly observations with unknown owned-citation state.

ownedCitationCoverageAmongKnownObservati.description: Owned-citing observations among monthly snapshots with a known state; null when none are known.

ownedCitationCoverageUpperBoundPercent.description: Monthly snapshot coverage upper bound assuming every unknown state hides an owned citation; deterministic completeness bound, not a confidence interval.

previousUnknownOwnedCitationStateObserva.description: Unknown-state observation share in the previous sampled month for this provider/cohort.

unknownOwnedCitationStateObservationShar.description: Change in unknown-state observation share from the previous sampled month.

unknownOwnedCitationStatePrompts.description: Prompt groups with no positive owned citation and at least one incomplete source list in this month.

unknownOwnedCitationStatePromptSharePerc.description: Share of monthly prompt groups with unknown owned-citation reach state.

ownedCitationPromptCoverageAmongKnownPro.description: Owned-cited prompt reach among prompt groups with a known state; null when none are known.

ownedCitationPromptCoverageUpperBoundPer.description: Monthly prompt-reach upper bound assuming every unknown group hides an owned citation; deterministic completeness bound, not a confidence interval.

previousUnknownOwnedCitationStatePromptS.description: Unknown-state prompt share in the previous sampled month for this provider/cohort.

unknownOwnedCitationStatePromptShareChan.description: Change in unknown-state prompt share from the previous sampled month.

ownedFirstCitationMeanReciprocalRankPerc.description: Snapshot-weighted mean reciprocal rank of the first owned citation, expressed as a percentage.

equalPromptMeanOwnedFirstCitationMrrPerc.description: Mean first-owned-citation reciprocal rank after averaging repeated captures within each exact prompt.

ownedFirstCitationMeanReciprocalRankPerc.description: Snapshot-weighted mean reciprocal rank of the first owned citation, expressed as a percentage.

equalPromptMeanOwnedFirstCitationMrrPerc.description: Mean first-owned-citation reciprocal rank after averaging repeated captures within each exact prompt.

promptsWithOwnedCitationReachKnownOnBoth.description: Matched prompt groups where both providers' owned-citation reach state is known; paired bootstrap and exact McNemar summaries use this complete-case subset.

incompleteCitationListObservations.description: Prompt/provider observations whose supplied citation list was marked or inferred incomplete. Optional for compatibility with older reports.

citedDomainCitationEvents.description: Optional event counts for retained cited domains, ordered by citation frequency; omitted by older saved reports.

rankWeightedDomainCitationEvents.description: Optional per-domain sum of 1/log2(rank+1) weights over retained prompt/provider citation events, ordered by weight.

rankWeightedCitationWeightTotal.description: Total reciprocal-log discount weight across all citation events in this prompt/provider group.

ownedFirstPositionCitationEvents.description: Optional owned rank-one citation-event count for the prompt/provider group; omitted by older saved reports.

ownedTopThreeCitationEvents.description: Optional owned rank-one-through-three citation-event count for the prompt/provider group; omitted by older saved reports.

ownedFirstCitationMeanReciprocalRankPerc.description: Optional mean reciprocal rank of the first owned citation across snapshots with an owned citation; omitted by older saved reports.

citedDomainDetailComplete.description: True only when neither period truncated its retained top-ten cited-domain list.

citationDomainJaccard.description: Distinct cited-domain Jaccard between baseline and current for this matched provider/prompt group; unavailable when either retained domain list is capped or both periods have no cited domains.

ownedPromptRankComparison.description: Optional exact-prompt-balanced owned citation rank and first-owned-citation reciprocal-rank comparison; omitted when owned domains are not configured.

positionBuckets.description: Citation-event distribution across preserved source-list ranks. Optional for compatibility with earlier version-1 reports.

incompleteCitationListsWithoutOwnedCitat.description: Entity-mentioned observations without an owned citation whose supplied source list was marked or inferred incomplete. Optional for compatibility with older reports.

providerUniquePrompts.description: Distinct exact-prompt denominator for this provider.

positionBucketChanges.description: Optional rank-bucket share comparisons; omitted by earlier version-1 reports.

ownedCitationPositionBucketChanges.description: Optional baseline/current rank-bucket changes; omitted by earlier version-1 reports.

promptFingerprint.description: Stable SHA-256 identifier of the normalized exact prompt; this is pseudonymous and is not anonymization.
